roleContext.roleTitle: Senior Channel Operations Analyst, Anti-Fraud Analytics Platform
roleContext.jobDescription: The anti-fraud analytics platform screens card and account-opening transactions for a group of regional banks. The Senior Channel Operations Analyst runs the operational side of the rule-review channel: intake of rule-change requests from the banks, impact checks, scheduling into the fortnightly release, and reporting to the fraud steering committee. The role requires a senior-level analyst with at least five years in fraud or payments operations; a CAMS or CFE certification is strongly preferred.

requirements.text: Senior-level analyst with at least five years of experience in fraud, risk or payments operations.
Holds a CAMS or CFE certification, or an equivalent anti-financial-crime qualification.
Runs intake and impact checks for rule-change requests from partner banks and schedules them into the fortnightly release.
Prepares the channel report for the fraud steering committee and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents known limitations and hand-over conditions at the end of each release cycle.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Senior Channel Operations Analyst, Anti-Fraud Analytics Platform

## Experience

- Ran intake for rule-change requests from three partner banks over two and a half years in the platform operations team, logging each request in the channel tracker, running the impact check against the last 30 days of screened transactions, and placing approved changes into the fortnightly release.
- Prepared the monthly channel report for the fraud steering committee, covering request volumes, release contents and open items; the report was reviewed and presented by the head of platform operations.
- Wrote the end-of-cycle notes for each release, listing rules deferred to the next cycle, the reason for deferral and the hand-over contact at each bank.
- Completed the ACAMS foundations e-learning modules and am currently preparing for the CAMS examination scheduled for later this year.
- Responsibilities included request intake, impact checks, release scheduling and committee reporting for the rule-review channel, working with two colleagues under the head of platform operations.

## Work samples

- Work sample: an anonymised channel tracker extract (request id, bank, impact-check result, release cycle, deferral reason) for two release cycles and the corresponding end-of-cycle notes, with the tracker's change history as a verification trail.
